## Platform Integration

M7 - Natural Language Processing can be integrated as a reusable module within the Villanova composable platform architecture.

## Integration Considerations

- Endpoint and credential management across environments.
- Configuration governance for defaults, limits, and policy constraints.
- Monitoring, logging, and operational observability controls.
- Role-based access and traceability for compliance-oriented deployments.
